description: This source file defines the ExpandableList2 class, which demonstrates the use of expandable lists backed by cursors in an Android application. It includes nested classes for handling asynchronous queries and providing a custom list adapter, managing contact and phone number data from the device's contacts provider.
external_methods: startQuery(token, cookie, uri, projection, selection, selectionArgs, order)

classes.name: ExpandableList2
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating expandable list views backed by contact data, managing query handlers and adapter setup.

classes.name: QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles asynchronous queries for contact groups and their children, updating the adapter with new cursors.

classes.name: MyExpandableListAdapter
classes.description: Custom adapter extending SimpleCursorTreeAdapter to fetch child data (phone numbers) for each contact group.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the list adapter, and begins querying contacts.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up by closing cursors and nulling references to prevent leaks.

methods.name: getChildrenCursor
methods.description: Fetches a cursor with phone numbers corresponding to a contact group.

calls: startQuery(TOKEN_GROUP, null, Contacts.CONTENT_URI, CONTACTS_PROJECTION, Contacts.HAS_PHONE_NUMBER + "=1", null, null)
